WITH signal_data AS (
  SELECT 
    COALESCE(rfistat, 'No Status') as rfistat,
    modindex
  FROM signals
  WHERE modindex IS NOT NULL
),
overall_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(modindex) as overall_avg
  FROM signal_data
),
status_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    rfistat,
    AVG(modindex) as status_avg
  FROM signal_data
  GROUP BY rfistat
),
above_average_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    ss.rfistat,
    ss.status_avg,
    oa.overall_avg
  FROM status_stats ss
  CROSS JOIN overall_average oa
  WHERE ss.status_avg > oa.overall_avg
),
mean_of_qualifying AS (
  SELECT AVG(status_avg) as qualifying_mean
  FROM above_average_stats
)
SELECT 
  aas.rfistat as status,
  aas.status_avg as average_modulation_index,
  aas.status_avg - aas.overall_avg as above_average,
  aas.status_avg - moq.qualifying_mean as difference_from_qualifying_mean
FROM above_average_stats aas
CROSS JOIN mean_of_qualifying moq
ORDER BY aas.rfistat
